title: Small touch to the reminder app
body: I love the reminder app,it serves to be very convenient especially to me who is the current student so every task that I have I always put a reminder onto it and in that way I’m never late I never forget about the important stuff that I need to accomplish. maybe something that I would like to add as a recommendation is to implement a way that you can. For example, you set a reminder to remind you every day about a specific due date, I would like to recommend that you can add a specific function whereby the reminder stop reminding you once you are done even before you reach that due date. thank you for your hard work.
